group_note: Six questions grouped on structure "plain", and two members do not belong with the rest on E1: 2015_A#q014 is structure_options, because its four options are drawn structures, and 2015_A#q018 is statement_options, because its stem is only "Which of the statements given below is incorrect?" and the content lives in the options. q018 is also the only member scored several_independent_checks on the evidence of its task, which needs a verdict on each of four unrelated claims; q015 is scored the same way for a different reason, that the four electron totals are worked out separately and then compared, and that is stated here so the two are not read as one pattern. The other four are single_step. Demand was set by what the student actually does: recall where one stored item decides it (q016's named reaction, q017's stored percentage), application where a stated rule or convention is applied to this case (q014's Markovnikov rule, q019's naming rules), calculation where numbers are produced and compared (q015), and concept_discrimination where the live decision is a definition boundary (q018's oxide against fluoride). q014 is the one damaged member: all four of its options are stored as the placeholder "[structure diagram]", so it carries source_damage_artifact with empty traps and only the certain fields filled, and no trap is inferred from a question we cannot see. Elimination was granted once, to q019, on a fact separate from the answer (six printed CN groups force hexa). It was withheld from q015 and q017, where the only fact that strikes an option out is the fact that answers the question. On the trap axis each route names an option and a mis-step, and three members carry a device drawn from a neighbour rather than from an error: the intermediate before hydrolysis and the carbon-tetrachloride product in q016, and the close-packed and simple-cubic figures in q017. Two options are reached by no route and both are demonstrated rather than asserted - q016 option 3 would need a chlorine swapped for hydrogen that no printed reagent performs, and q017 option 1 matches none of the three standard packing figures and is the key's digits reversed, a device no live label names precisely, which q017's note records. q015 carries only one trap of three wrong options, and its note says which mis-steps were tried against the other two and why none lands on one option rather than the other. No trap is placed on any official answer.
